name: io.github.teramoby/speedle-mcp
title: Speedle
description: MCP server for self-hosted Speedle and Speedle Cloud: authorization checks and policy management

packageArguments.description: Authorization check mode. Registers only the check tools and reads only ADS configuration.

environmentVariables.name: SPEEDLE_ENDPOINT
environmentVariables.description: ADS base URL, for example https://cloud.speedle.io or http://127.0.0.1:6734.

environmentVariables.name: SPEEDLE_ADS_ENDPOINT
environmentVariables.description: Alias of SPEEDLE_ENDPOINT.

environmentVariables.name: SPEEDLE_ADS_URL
environmentVariables.description: Alias of SPEEDLE_ENDPOINT.

environmentVariables.name: SPEEDLE_SERVICE_NAME
environmentVariables.description: Service name sent on every authorization check. Callers cannot override it.

environmentVariables.name: SPEEDLE_SERVICE
environmentVariables.description: Alias of SPEEDLE_SERVICE_NAME.

environmentVariables.name: SPEEDLE_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: API key (bearer token) for Speedle Cloud. Required for Speedle Cloud; omit it for a self-hosted ADS without an API key or bearer token. The endpoint must use https://. Never logged or echoed.

environmentVariables.name: SPEEDLE_ADS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Alias of SPEEDLE_TOKEN.

environmentVariables.name: SPEEDLE_BACKEND
environmentVariables.description: speedle-cloud or speedle. Defaults to speedle-cloud when SPEEDLE_TOKEN is set, and speedle otherwise.

environmentVariables.name: SPEEDLE_ALLOW_INSECURE_HTTP
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to allow http:// to a non-loopback host for backend speedle without an API key or bearer token.

environmentVariables.name: SPEEDLE_CA_CERT
environmentVariables.description: Extra PEM CA certificate for a self-hosted https:// server.

environmentVariables.name: SPEEDLE_EXPOSE_DIAGNOSE
environmentVariables.description: Set to true or 1 to register diagnose. Self-hosted speedle only; refused on speedle-cloud.

environmentVariables.name: SPEEDLE_EXPOSE_ALL_GRANTED_ROLES
environmentVariables.description: Set to true or 1 to register all_granted_roles.

environmentVariables.name: SPEEDLE_EXPOSE_ALL_GRANTED_PERMISSIONS
environmentVariables.description: Set to true or 1 to register all_granted_permissions.

packageArguments.description: Policy management mode. Registers only the management tools and reads only PMS configuration.

environmentVariables.name: SPEEDLE_PMS_ENDPOINT
environmentVariables.description: PMS or Speedle Cloud base URL, for example http://127.0.0.1:6733 or https://cloud.speedle.io. A trailing /policy-mgmt/v1 is accepted.

environmentVariables.name: SPEEDLE_PMS_BACKEND
environmentVariables.description: speedle-cloud or speedle. Defaults to speedle. SPEEDLE_PMS_TOKEN alone does not select Speedle Cloud.

environmentVariables.name: SPEEDLE_PMS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: API key (bearer token). Required for speedle-cloud, with scope pms:read or pms:write. The endpoint must use https://. Never logged or echoed.

environmentVariables.name: SPEEDLE_PMS_CERT
environmentVariables.description: PEM client certificate for mutual TLS. Requires SPEEDLE_PMS_KEY. Cannot be combined with SPEEDLE_PMS_TOKEN.

environmentVariables.name: SPEEDLE_PMS_KEY
environmentVariables.description: PEM private key for mutual TLS. Requires SPEEDLE_PMS_CERT. Never logged or echoed.

environmentVariables.name: SPEEDLE_PMS_ALLOW_INSECURE_HTTP
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to allow http:// to a non-loopback host without credentials.

environmentVariables.name: SPEEDLE_PMS_CA_CERT
environmentVariables.description: Extra PEM CA certificate for a self-hosted https:// server.

environmentVariables.name: SPEEDLE_PMS_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to register only the read tools. Same effect as passing --read-only.
